notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Satyr Hedonist.
You have discarded at least two cards this turn.
description:
Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Satyr Hedonist due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Hollow One by paying {R} and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.
